description: Post-quantum signatures (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, hybrids with Ed25519), ML-KEM and HQC, SHA-2/SHA-3 and sealed file capsules, from the NOQTIS C11 library through the Foreign Function and Memory API (JDK 22 or later); the jar carries the library for Linux, macOS and Windows on x86-64 and arm64.
